### Building a New PC – Step‑by‑Step Guide Below is a practical, beginner‑friendly walkthrough. Feel free to skip sections you already know, but keep the order for best results. | # | Step | What to Do | Tips | |---|------|------------|------| | 1 | **Plan & Budget** | • Decide what you’ll use it for (gaming, video editing, office, etc.)
• Set a budget (CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, case, PSU, peripherals). | Use PCPartPicker.com to check compatibility and price‑track parts. | | 2 | **Gather Tools & Workspace** | • Phillips‑head screwdriver (magnetic tip helps).
• Anti‑static wrist strap (optional but recommended).
• Clean, flat, static‑free surface. | Keep the case open on a non‑metal table. | | 3 | **Choose a Case** | • Size: ATX, Micro‑ATX, Mini‑ITX.
• Airflow: front/mid intake, rear exhaust. | Check cable‑management features. | | 4 | **Select Power Supply (PSU)** | • Wattage: 450W–850W for mid‑range builds; 1000W+ for high‑end.
• 80+ Gold or better for efficiency. | Make sure it has enough PCIe connectors for your GPU. | | 5 | **Pick a Motherboard** | • CPU socket (e.g., LGA 1700 for Intel, AM4/AM5 for AMD).
• Chipset (Z690, B550, etc.) for overclocking or features. | Verify form factor matches case. | | 6 | **Choose CPU & Cooler** | • CPU: Core i5/i7/i9, Ryzen 5/7/9, etc.
• Cooler: Stock cooler (if included) or aftermarket air/ AIO liquid cooler. | Check socket compatibility. | | 7 | **Install RAM** | • DDR4/DDR5 sticks, 8–32 GB total.
• Insert into DIMM slots at the correct notch. | Install in matching pairs for dual‑channel. | | 8 | **Mount the Motherboard** | • Align standoffs in the case with motherboard holes.
• Secure with screws. | Don’t overtighten; leave a little wiggle. | | 9 | **Install the PSU** | • Place in the case’s PSU bay (usually bottom rear).
• Connect the 24‑pin ATX and 8‑pin CPU power cables to the motherboard. | Route cables neatly; use Velcro ties. | |10 | **Install Storage** | • SSD (NVMe M.2 or SATA) and/or HDD.
• Mount M.2 in the motherboard slot; secure with screw.
• SATA drives go into 3.5″ or 2.5″ bays. | Label cables if you have multiple drives. | |11 | **Install GPU** | • Insert into the top PCIe x16 slot.
• Secure with screws to the case.
• Connect 6‑pin/8‑pin PCIe power from PSU. | Ensure the GPU fits in the case (length, height). | |12 | **Connect Front Panel & USB** | • Refer to motherboard manual for pin layout.
• Connect power button, reset, USB, audio jacks. | Double‑check orientation; reverse polarity will damage. | |13 | **Cable Management** | • Tidy up cables using ties or Velcro straps.
• Route cables through cable‑gaps or behind motherboard tray. | Good airflow = better cooling. | |14 | **First Boot** | • Connect monitor, keyboard, mouse, power cable.
• Turn on PSU switch, then press the case power button. | If nothing appears, double‑check power connections. | |15 | **Enter BIOS/UEFI** | • Press key (Del/F2) during boot.
• Verify CPU, RAM, storage detected.
• Set boot priority to your OS drive. | Save changes before exiting. | |16 | **Install Operating System** | • Create bootable USB (Windows 10/11, Ubuntu, etc.).
• Boot from USB, follow installer prompts. | Install drivers after OS installation. | |17 | **Install Drivers & Updates** | • GPU driver (NVIDIA/AMD), chipset, network, audio.
• Run Windows Update or equivalent. | Keep drivers up‑to‑date for performance & security. | |18 | **Test & Benchmark** | • Run stress tests (Prime95, 3DMark, Cinebench).
• Monitor temperatures (HWMonitor, MSI Afterburner). | Ensure temps stay within safe limits. | |19 | **Final Touches** | • Add RGB lighting, fans, or additional accessories.
• Clean dust filters. | Keep the system clean for longevity. | --- #### Quick Checklist - [ ] CPU + cooler installed - [ ] Motherboard mounted - [ ] RAM seated - [ ] PSU connected - [ ] Storage installed - [ ] GPU installed - [ ] Front panel connectors attached - [ ] Cables managed - [ ] First boot successful - [ ] OS installed - [ ] Drivers updated - [ ] Benchmarked --- #### Common Pitfalls & Fixes | Issue | Likely Cause | Fix | |-------|--------------|-----| | No display | GPU not seated or power cable missing | Re‑insert GPU, connect power cable | | No power | PSU switch off or cable loose | Turn PSU on, tighten cables | | Overheating | Poor airflow or fan miswired | Re‑route cables, add intake fans | | BIOS not detecting CPU | Wrong socket or CPU not seated | Check socket, reseat CPU | --- #### Resources - **PCPartPicker** – Build planner & compatibility checker. - **YouTube** – “How to build a PC” series (e.g., Linus Tech Tips, JayzTwoCents). - **Manuals** – Keep motherboard, PSU, and case manuals handy. - **Forums** – r/buildapc on Reddit for troubleshooting. Happy building! If you hit a snag, let me know the exact problem and I’ll help troubleshoot.
